scripts.desktop: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npm run build:phone-link && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5190 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5190 && electron . --dev"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && npm run build:phone-link && vite build
scripts.package:mac: node node_modules/electron/install.js && node scripts/create-icons.mjs && npm run build && python3 scripts/package-macos.py
scripts.build:phone-link: mkdir -p dist-electron && swiftc -O native/phone-link/Shared/*.swift native/phone-link/PhoneLinkCore.swift native/phone-link/CableLink.swift native/phone-link/PhoneLinkHelper.swift -o dist-electron/runes-phone-link
scripts.test:phone-link: sh scripts/sync-relay-wire.sh --check && mkdir -p dist-electron && swiftc native/phone-link/Shared/*.swift native/phone-link/PhoneLinkCore.swift native/phone-link/Tests/PhoneLinkCoreTests.swift -o dist-electron/phone-link-tests && dist-electron/phone-link-tests
